en.html:
I hurried to the field.
So terribly late that the thought even <ruby>crossed my mind<rt>crossed my mind</rt></ruby>: perhaps I was already too late.

No room for doubt now. Believe that time remained. Run, begrudging every instant, every hair's breadth.

ja.html:
馳せ参ず。
　余りにも遅きに失し、あるいは、間に合わなかった
のではないか――という疑念さえ<ruby>過<rt>よ</rt></ruby>ぎるも。

　今は迷いを抱くべからず。
　時に残余があるを信じ、一瞬一毫を惜しんで駆ける。

en.html:
The enemy's huge body was directly ahead.
On the ground, motionless for the moment.

Something had happened just before: the demon had lost control of its flight and made a forced landing. Only now was there a sign of it starting to move.

I saw no sign that any attack had struck it, from anywhere.
—Such thinking could wait for later.

ja.html:
敵の巨躯は正面に有り。
　地表にあって今は不動。

　直前、何事があったのか、かの怪鬼は騎航を乱して
不時着している。
　いま漸う、動き出そうとする気配がある。

　何処からも攻撃を受けたようには見えなかったが。
　――そんな思索も後で良し。

en.html:
I went straight on.

Whether by the armor's detection function or by the pilot's instinct, the giant warrior seemed to have sensed me. Faster than I had expected, it swung its main front toward me.

The gun-ports turned my way—
And spat fire.

ja.html:
ひた進む。

　劔冑の探査機能か、あるいは仕手の直感か、
　察したらしい巨大な武者は予想以上に素早い動きで、
こちらへ主攻正面を転換する。

　砲門群が向く――
　火を噴き放つ。
ja.text:

　火を噴き放つ。

en.html:
I pressed on regardless.
No strength was left to spare for caring, anyway.

Grains of steel shaved the armor, and the grains behind shaved it further. How many more seconds before this concentrated fire, from a marksman of outstanding skill, broke the iron wall and reached the soft flesh?

The worry flashed once—
And was forgotten.

Go now.
Only forward.

The one point I had memorized.
The only weakness that could bring down that grand bearing.

The pilot's seat.
Towards that place—

I advanced.

ja.html:
委細構わず突き進む。
　構うだけの余力もない。

　鋼の粒が甲鉄を削り、続く粒が更に削る。
　卓抜した射撃技量の成し遂げる集中弾が鉄壁を破り
脆弱な肉に到達するまで、あと何秒が要るのであろう。

　そんな危惧が刹那ひらめき、
　そのまま忘れる。

　今は行け。
　ただ前へ進め。

　記憶したその一点。
　偉容を崩し得る唯一の急所。

　仕手の搭乗位置。
　其処を目掛け。

　進む。
